mechanism: Telmisartan blocks angiotensin II-mediated aldosterone suppression, reducing urinary potassium excretion and increasing serum potassium levels, particularly in patients with renal impairment or diabetes.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly; assess renal function baseline and periodically; consider potassium supplementation contraindicated or restricted; educate patients to avoid high-potassium foods and salt substitutes.
